blocks.text: Building on Laura's note, and because the preparation sessions are the one part of the schedule that depends on your executives' calendars and not on ours, I wanted to set out how we would like to run them before you begin asking people for their time:

1. Each spokesperson should complete a session before any interview is booked for them, and we can hold it at your offices or by video, whichever suits the people involved.
2. A session runs about half a day and covers the core messages for Kirby-Taylor, practice interviews built around the questions reporters are most likely to ask, and the subjects we recommend leaving to the company's formal disclosures.
3. If an executive cannot find the time before the first round of outreach, we will leave that person out of it and bring them into a later round once their session has been held.

If you can send us the names and a rough sense of availability by the middle of next week, Laura will propose dates on this thread, and we will fit the outreach schedule for {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} around whatever you confirm.
